t.E150a.agn: The group ADI for caramel colours (E150a–d) is 300 mg/kg body weight. In its refined estimate in 2012 EFSA reported that this limit was not exceeded in any age group.
t.E150a.prod: Obtained by controlled heat treatment of carbohydrates such as sugar.
t.E150a.regx.0: Group ADI 300 mg/kg (E150a–d); not exceeded in the refined estimate.
t.E150a.summary: A plain caramel colour obtained by heating sugar. It gives a brown colour; it is used in cola, beer, sauces and bakery products.
